items.title: Mose Allison — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I played a gig with him at the Five Spot for a month

ctx.x: Reading Monk’s biography, I think he got involved with Monk in the early ‘60s...
I was left out of Monk’s biography. I played a gig with him at the Five Spot for a month, and it was left out of the biography.
Do you recall who was in Monk’s band at the time?
